nodes.label: SentencePieceProcessor
nodes.desc: Top-level inference facade: Load, Encode, Decode, NBestEncode, SampleEncode, PieceToId/IdToPiece.

nodes.label: SentencePieceTrainer
nodes.desc: Entry point for training; parses flags/keyword args and wires up the right trainer components.

nodes.label: ModelInterface
nodes.desc: Base class of all models: InitializePieces builds the piece-to-id map, PieceToId/IdToPiece are the abacus.

nodes.label: unigram::Model
nodes.desc: Unigram LM model: builds a lattice, runs Viterbi (EncodeOptimized) to pick the best segmentation.

nodes.label: bpe::Model
nodes.desc: BPE model: greedy priority-queue merges of adjacent symbols; Encode = SampleEncode with alpha 0.

nodes.label: word::Model
nodes.desc: Word model: whitespace-tokenized lookup, the simplest segmentation strategy.

nodes.label: char::Model
nodes.desc: Character model: every character becomes a piece; fallback of last resort.

nodes.label: ModelFactory
nodes.desc: Switch over trainer_spec.model_type (UNIGRAM/BPE/WORD/CHAR) that instantiates the concrete model.

nodes.label: Normalizer
nodes.desc: Applies NFKC or user-defined charsmap rules and escapes whitespace to the U+2581 meta symbol.

nodes.label: TrainerInterface
nodes.desc: Shared trainer base: LoadSentences, character_coverage required_chars, IsValidSentencePiece, Serialize, Save.

nodes.label: ModelProto
nodes.desc: The .model protobuf: repeated SentencePiece pieces plus trainer_spec and normalizer_spec.

nodes.label: pybind11 module
nodes.desc: _sentencepiece extension module binding SentencePieceProcessor and Trainer APIs to Python.
